generated.note: Shore/reed glyphs mechanically decoded from the "static" group, quantized to a 26-key palette (ColoredSprite requires single-char colour keys, so per-pixel unbounded keys were not an option), then column-doubled. The water body itself is a fitted ellipse (WCX/WCY/WRX/WRY below), not a transcription of the reference's water-a/water-b ripple glyphs -- water is animated at runtime by pondFrame() (src/pondAnim.ts), the waterfall's own pond-cell formula reused standalone.
